This appears in the [[Marquis Teodoro Jr.|Marquis' quest]], and once built unlocks the [[Camp bed]] technology, which permits the aristocrat refugees to grow their own food. Combined with the [[Cook]] in her [[GoC Cooking table|kitchen]], this will provide a continuous free food supply.
